title: Rav Nachman bar Papa

paragraphs: Mentioned in Bava Metzia 80b, raising an objection to Rafram bar Papa.
He was very pious: Chullin 60b relates that he planted his garden but nothing grew. He prayed for mercy, rain came and it sprouted. He said, “This illustrates Rav Assi's teaching.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman calls him pious on the basis of the garden-and-rain account. The final phrase says that the event illustrates Rav Assi’s teaching.

Rafram bar Papa continues across the Hebrew line break. Hyman’s citations are Bava Metzia 80b and Chullin 60b. “This illustrates Rav Assi’s teaching” renders the closing היינו דרב אסי; Hyman does not quote the teaching itself here.
